slides.heading: Setup: iPhone (Off Grid)
slides.body:
1. Open the App Store and search "Off Grid"
2. Install the app (free, no account needed)
3. Open Off Grid and tap the model browser
4. Models are filtered by your device's RAM
5. Tap a model (start with Qwen 3 0.6B or 1.5B)
6. Download over Wi-Fi (80MB to 4GB)
7. Once downloaded, start chatting instantly

slides.heading: Setup: Android (Off Grid)
slides.body:
1. Open Play Store and search "Off Grid"
2. Install the app (free, open source, MIT license)
3. Open Off Grid and browse recommended models
4. Pick a model based on your RAM (6GB+ needed)
5. Download over Wi-Fi (80MB to 4GB)
6. Turn on airplane mode to verify it works
7. Start chatting with zero internet

slides.heading: Pro Tip: Speed Boost
slides.body:
After your first chat, go to Settings

Find "KV Cache Quantization"

Switch from f16 to q4_0

This roughly triples inference speed
with minimal quality loss

Also: First message is always slower
as the model loads into memory
Subsequent messages are much faster

AI that works without
the internet is not a feature.

It's the future.
